Tolan, an AI assistant aimed at non-tech-savvy users, has raised $30M from USV, Khosla Ventures and Homebrew. The company says about 250,000 everyday users turn to it as a friendly voice and that 70% of its users are women - a deliberate counter-positioning to the enthusiast chatbot market, and a demographic profile that stands out against Pew's findings of heavier male usage elsewhere.
